limitations: A meg recording may contain simultaneous EEG channels; meg paths never establish absence of EEG
EDF, BDF, FIF, NWB and general numeric extensions never establish scalp EEG content without headers
Archive filenames remain uninspected even when the name contains EEG
EEG JSON, VHDR and VMRK are tracked as companion candidates, not waveform byte totals
EEGLAB SET can embed samples or refer to FDT; queue bytes are not unique recordings or hours
Known bytes sum published file sizes, including other modalities and distinct release versions
Category file and byte totals are additive; category release counts overlap and must not be added
No queue status, ordering, inclusion, download or training approval is changed
